item.title: Artist's Ground Zero sketches capture destruction and recovery
item.description: Artist John Coburn went to Ground Zero after the 9/11 attacks, drawing scenes of destruction, recovery, and daily life as a way to document the site.

item.title: Irish leaders react to Trump's comment on a unified Ireland
item.description: President Donald Trump drew criticism from some Irish leaders after arriving in Dublin Saturday when he expressed interest in seeing a unified Ireland.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis tighten control over key oil shipping lane
item.description: The Houthis' moves make it easier for the Iran-backed rebels to target ships carrying Saudi Arabian oil through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: David Muir shares 9/11 tribute with drones lighting NYC skyline
item.description: Thousands of drones illuminated lower Manhattan, with one light for each person lost on September 11th. David Muir shares how the tribute came together.
